name: Prince Abdin

facts.text: Level 78, 100,000 health, a prince of Darkness Falls; no scripted mechanic beyond his reset.
Darkness Falls' bestiary lists its princes among the court.

story: Prince Abdin is the eldest of the princes of the court below, and the most proud of it. He has no tricks. He does not need them, he says: a prince is a prince because he is stronger than what is under him, and that is all. He keeps wagers with the other princes on which of the three realms will come down through its door next, and the imps say he lost heavily on Albion one season and has hated it since. He expects visitors to kneel. Few do.
legend: The honest prince: no pet-eating, no clones, no tricks, just a lot of health and a hard hitter. Tank him, heal him, burn him. He is one of the four royals you need dead before Beliathan rises, so do not skip him to save time.

aggro: Kneel, mortal. I will make it quick.
death: A prince... of the court... falls...

lairEntry: A prince's hall. He expects you to kneel.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Prince Abdin has fallen. The court loses a wager.
